name: BT Spirit Wear
changelog:
1.0.0

  • The spirit wear landing page and lead form moved out of Code Snippets into a real plugin, with the same updater as the other BT plugins. Future changes arrive as an update instead of code edits.
  • Apostrophes no longer arrive in lead emails as We\'re or Child\'s. Every form field is now unslashed before it is used.
  • While the old Code Snippets version is still active the plugin stands by and shows a notice, so leads are never emailed twice. Deactivate the snippet and the plugin takes over.
